instruments.instrument: tin_s (IRPS personal income tax, schedules 1 and 3)

Lei 5/2009 de 12 de Janeiro (75.000,00MT annual or 3% of turnover)

Codigo do IVA (Lei 32/2007, tranche-2) as revised by Lei 3/2012; the 2023 rate instrument = tranche-2
Lei 17/2009 ICE and fuel-tax instruments (tranche-2 captures)
